_help: One section per AI step. Edit this file to switch models or go back to simulated AI. Changes apply to the next request; click Reset demo in the prototype to re-run the search.

resume_parsing._what: Reads the resume into facts on the 'Verify your profile' screen.

job_matching._what: Finds open roles (web search agent or sample list), hides ones not relevant to the candidate's career stage, ranks the rest by interview chance, shows matches/gaps per requirement.
job_matching._mode_options: real = call the AI model below. simulated = use the canned answers in simulated_responses.json (no API key needed, no cost).
job_matching._role_source_options: web_search = the AI searches the web for real open roles (slower: 1 to 2.5 minutes and about 30 cents to 1 dollar per run in testing). sample_list = rank the fixed sample roles in simulated_responses.json (faster, cheaper, same roles every time).
